draft_text: Under 10% label noise, Thornbill-NER's F1 dropped by only 0.6 points, within the pre-specified robustness criterion.
rationale: The package contains only original-label results (T1) and no label-noise experiments. The claimed 0.6-point drop under 10% noise and the robustness-criterion comparison rest on a table (T2) that is not supplied. No defensible narrower version is supported.
